set.body:
Scope: modules/transform; optional neuroim4s transform and platform IO modules.

Deliverable: Move ITK/ANTs, FSL, AFNI, FreeSurfer and X5 codecs, typed interpretation and conversion over shared world declarations. Generic transform algebra, numerical inverse solvers and resampling remain in reframe4s/Gale.

Acceptance:
- Toolkit transform fixtures/oracles pass on JVM/JS where portable; JVM HDF5/file IO stays platform-specific.
- Directionality, unavailable inverse, scanner/tkRAS placement and transforms-applied-once semantics are preserved.
- No duplicated affine/warp/solver implementation or surface dependency enters neuroim4s; public composition works outside ScalaFIM.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: I1: Extract toolkit transform formats and anatomical interpretation
